question.text: A client has LTCG of Rs. 2 lakh on listed equity. Tax (post Jul 2024):

explanation.text: The Logic: Taxable LTCG = 2,00,000 - 1,25,000 = 75,000 * 12.5% = Rs. 9,375. The Trap: Nil ignores threshold; others miscalc rate. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Remind clients: LTCG > Rs. 1.25 lakh attracts tax regardless of overall income slab.
